verdict.rationale: Ollama's docs describe a unified interface where the same CLI/API can target local models or Ollama's own hosted Cloud models via local/cloud base URLs and API keys, letting users 'run larger models on Ollama's Cloud without the download' and switch models without changing workflow. However, this is limited to Ollama's own cloud service rather than third-party cloud providers (OpenAI/Anthropic connections are documented as inbound compatibility for external clients, not Ollama connecting outward to their clouds), and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming seamless mixed local+cloud usage in a single session. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of mixed local/cloud workflows, and evidence of connecting to third-party cloud providers (not just Ollama's own cloud) within the same interface.
